title: Delegation
description: Who has handed which decision classes to whom. The founder (the chief delegator) is the root and holds every class; every other role holds only what a grant gives it, and may pass on only what it holds with may_redelegate. Classes listed in never_redelegated may be granted by the founder but not passed on; classes in one_way_doors are never delegated at all. The template lives at governance/venture-template/delegation.json; a venture keeps its own at <venture>/governance/delegation.json. Checked by schema/check-delegation.mjs.

extends.description: A venture file: path to the template it customizes

founder.description: The people who hold the root role, by name. Only they approve a one-way publication (schema/publish.mjs) or merge as the founder (schema/decisions.mjs). The template leaves it out; a venture names its own founders

one_way_doors.description: Irreversible classes; they stay with the founder

scope.description: "venture" for all of it, or a route or path prefix such as engineering/ that narrows it

may_merge.description: May merge or land work under these classes without the grantor

expires.description: Last day the grant holds; null for until revoked

decision.description: The decision that made the grant
